text: APPROVE: the extracted `IsInterpreterDirective` keeps the original `prefix == "#" && i + 1 < line.Length && line[i + 1] == '!'` condition, so behaviour is unchanged. The ternary replaces the nested `if` at the same nesting depth and drops the `&&` sequence from the method, which takes the complexity from 16 to 15. The helper is a private static method that takes a `ReadOnlySpan<char>`, which `line` converts to whether it is a string or a span, so the build should be unaffected. I judged this from the diff alone and did not run the build or the analyzer.
